label: Bible Study
prompt: He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord GOD will wipe away _____ from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for the LORD hath spoken it.
verse: He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for the LORD hath spoken it.
note: Paul quotes the first half; Revelation 21 echoes the second — God himself wiping the tears.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free _____.
verse: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
note: Freedom from the Son isn't a technicality or a trial run — it's 'free indeed.'

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like _____ made with honey.
verse: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.
note: Manna's flavor review: white like coriander seed, tasting like wafers made with honey.

label: Deep Water
prompt: I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the _____ of hell and of death.
verse: I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.
note: The risen Christ to a terrified John: he holds the keys of death and hell — every locked door answers to him.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And one of his servants said, None, my lord, O king: but Elisha, the prophet that is in Israel, telleth the king of Israel the words that thou speakest in thy _____.
verse: And one of his servants said, None, my lord, O king: but Elisha, the prophet that is in Israel, telleth the king of Israel the words that thou speakest in thy bedchamber.
note: Syria's king suspected a spy; his servant explained that Elisha told Israel's king even what was said 'in thy bedchamber.'
